Alex: quick question — how should the chat/completions contract behave when the primary model streams a tool_call but we fail over to a fallback model that doesn't support tool/function calling? :thinking:

Priya: +1 this is messy. my expectation: we should never send a partial tool_call delta that then disappears without explanation. need a clear final shape clients can rely on.

Alex: example stream fragment we might get from primary:
```json
{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": "q=redwood batching"}}}
```
then fallback kicks in and final response becomes text-only. what's the stable contract for the final message and the stream?

Dan: current runtime behavior (FYI) is we drop the `tool_call` and emit final assistant text + a system note. logs show: `fallback to model-x-no-tools, dropped tool_call`. not ideal.

Li: two reasonable options IMO:
1) Normalize: final message keeps `tool_call": null` and add `fallback_reason` metadata so clients know tool call was lost.
2) Augment: keep a `tool_call` object but add `metadata.available=false` + `fallback_reason` so clients can introspect and optionally render a fallback UI.
I slightly prefer (2) because it preserves shape for SDKs.

Jen: prefer minimal surface area for clients. propose this contract: final message includes `fallback` top-level field when fallback occurred, e.g.
```json
{"assistant": {"content": "...", "tool_call": null}, "fallback": {"to_model": "gpt-no-tools-1", "reason": "no-tool-support"}}
```
Clients get deterministic final shape. streaming deltas should include a terminal delta explaining the change.

Priya: +1 to adding explicit `fallback` metadata. also add an event type in the stream: `event: fallback_started` / `event: fallback_completed` so streaming clients can react. small, explicit hooks are easier than trying to infer. :+1:

Alex: sounds good. two asks: (a) can infra/runtime add `event: fallback_started` + terminal `event: fallback_completed` deltas when a model switch removes tool support? (b) can we standardize final fallback shape so SDKs don't need per-model heuristics?

Dan: will prototype. quick patch: emit `{"event":"fallback_started","to":"model-x","reason":"no-tools"}` and final `{"event":"fallback_completed","fallback_shape":{"tool_call":null}}`. will open PR with tests.

infra-bot: created INF-4321 to track design + tests — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 :rocket:

Alex: thanks all. i'll spin up a short design doc and tag reviewers. ping me @Priya @Dan if you want to pair on the PR.

Jen: i'll add a small compatibility test to the convo-api contract suite (edgecase: streaming tool_call -> text-only fallback).

Li: adding unit tests for SDK behavior as well.

Alex: leaving this async — will follow up in INF-4321 and the PR. :+1:
